verdict.rationale: Xero maintains an official OpenAPI spec, an official xero-node SDK on GitHub, and an official MCP server plus an AI Toolkit (OpenAI Agents SDK, LangChain, MCP) documented on developer.xero.com, giving AI-native developers multiple sanctioned ways to build against Xero programmatically. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on corroboration of SDK reliability and broader multi-language SDK coverage beyond Node.js.
